# עוזי וגלית Uzi & Galit – בית קפה, קונדיטוריה וקייטרינג לאירועים, תל אביב

> Uzi & Galit (עוזי וגלית) is a neighbourhood café and pâtisserie with event catering at 8 Aharon Becker St (Mikado shopping centre), North Tel Aviv. Kosher dairy kitchen. Fresh pastries, sandwiches, salads, quiches, cakes, dairy party platters (מגשי אירוח), picnic baskets and catering for events (brit, bar mitzvah, birthdays, company events, Shabbat).

- Address: אהרון בקר 8, תל אביב (32.122882, 34.816512)
- Hours (to confirm): Sunday–Thursday 07:00–20:00, Friday 07:00–15:00, closed Saturday
- Orders & WhatsApp: +972 52-889-7604 (https://wa.me/972528897604)
- Café phone: 03-644-6050
- Delivery: Wolt https://wolt.com/he/isr/tel-aviv/restaurant/uzi-galit
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/uzingalit/
- Party platters: office happy hour boxes from 468 ₪, sandwich platter (12) 200 ₪, mini quiche platter (12) 110 ₪, sweet pastry box from 49 ₪
- Kids: couscous & soup 39 ₪. Hanukkah sufganiyot 5–11 ₪.
